$comment: [S-6020] The Clock's word style. wordClock.hours: one or more hour forms separated by ';', each 12 entries (index 0 = twelve, then one..eleven) or 24 entries (index 0 = midnight .. 23) separated by '|'. wordClock.mNN: the sentence for NN minutes past the hour (rounded to the nearest five). In a sentence [h] is the hour in form 1, [n] the next hour in form 1, [h2]/[n2] form 2, and so on. The first letter of the result is capitalised.
